kind: must-be-deep
depth: deep
reason: deep-count-for-each
-- base/main.tf --
data "aws_subnets" "this" {
  filter {
    name   = "vpc-id"
    values = [var.vpc_id]
  }
}

resource "aws_route_table_association" "this" {
  for_each       = toset(data.aws_subnets.this.ids)
  subnet_id      = each.value
  route_table_id = var.route_table_id
}

variable "vpc_id" {
  type = string
}

variable "route_table_id" {
  type = string
}
-- head/main.tf --
data "aws_subnets" "this" {
  filter {
    name   = "tag:Vpc"
    values = [var.vpc_id]
  }
}

resource "aws_route_table_association" "this" {
  for_each       = toset(data.aws_subnets.this.ids)
  subnet_id      = each.value
  route_table_id = var.route_table_id
}

variable "vpc_id" {
  type = string
}

variable "route_table_id" {
  type = string
}
